scope: fresh authenticated local dev-8 workspace and two owned image-web services; final patched API; no production or Render-account mutation
length_contract: 100 Unicode code points after ordinary whitespace trim; raw controls and U+2028/U+2029 rejected before trim
state_invariants: Every refusal preserved both service names/IDs/routing and target deploy history. Accepted renames preserved immutableName, slug, URL, IDs, control service, and deploy history. Both CLI text tables had exactly one physical row per service.
harness_limit: The first dense run hit the default 500/minute caller limiter on a read-back GraphQL snapshot after 98 completed checks. Remaining checks resumed with pacing and completed cases skipped. No product assertion failed; API rate settings unchanged. See harness-transients.jsonl.
limits: Pinned CLI trims edge whitespace before HTTP and treats empty --name as no update; raw-edge/control and clear contracts were verified through REST/GraphQL/MCP. CLI interior controls, length/typed-ID refusals, trimming, boundaries and text tables were verified.
Exact Render display-name length/control/ID rules remain unverified; 100 code points is a Bex boundary, not claimed as an observed Render limit.

Dashboard hook/mutation/error-toast routing was inspected in source; direct GraphQL mutation was tested live. Visual header/list/breadcrumb rendering was not exercised because the local dashboard was not running.
evidence_policy: Only sanitized whitelist published; private auth state, CLI configs, kubeconfig, test env and raw API logs excluded. Full original request evidence remains in the private temporary working directory.
